title: TradeItem
description:
A single contracted lot, carried as one line of a trade document.
Based on SupplyChainTradeLineItem rather than LineTradeAgreement, which has
neither a quantity nor a product. The lot reference is in `identifier` or
`associatedDocumentLineDocument.lineId`.
See docs/model-guide.md §2.2.

suppliedProduct.description: The goods on this line, including their description.

Product.title: Product
Product.description:
The goods on a line: `description` for the free text, `name` for the mark,
`designation` for the grade, `originCountry` for the origin.

description.description: A textual description for this trade product.

identifier.description: A unique identifier for this trade product.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, for this trade product.

ProductPackage.title: ProductPackage
ProductPackage.description:
How the goods are packed: the coded package type, plus its trade name in
`description` when the document names a brand such as a hermetic liner.

capacityMeasure.description: The measure of the capacity of this supply chain packaging.

packageTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of supply chain packaging.

MonetaryAmount.title: MonetaryAmount
MonetaryAmount.description:
A monetary amount. Both the value and its currency are mandatory: an amount
without one of them cannot be acted on.

Measure.title: Measure
Measure.description:
A measured value such as a weight. The unit itself has no home:
IUneceMeasureCode declares no value property, so `MeasureTypeCode` cannot
carry "kgs".
